meanings.note: Russian perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to be enough', forming an aspectual pair with 'хватать'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

examples.text: Хватит кричать моё имя на всю кухню!
examples.trans: Stop shouting my name across the whole kitchen!

examples.text: Эй, кто здесь? Хватит глупо шутить, откройте!
examples.trans: Hey, who is here? Stop joking foolishly, open up!

examples.text: Денег не хватило.
examples.trans: There wasn't enough money.

meanings.note: Russian imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to shout', forming an aspectual pair with 'крикнуть'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

examples.text: Хватит кричать моё имя на всю кухню!
